extName.message: Tirai: privacy curtain for WhatsApp Web

extDescription.message: Blurs the WhatsApp Web chats you are not reading, masks ID and bank numbers, and covers everything while you share your screen.

pillShare.message: Screen sharing detected · everything is covered

cmdToggleFull.message: Switch between Normal and Full, or cover this tab

cmdToggleOff.message: Turn Tirai off or back on

statusFull.message: Everything on WhatsApp Web is covered

statusShare.message: You are sharing your screen, so everything is covered

statusFallback.message: WhatsApp's layout was not recognised, so Tirai covers the whole page for now

statusReload.message: Reload WhatsApp Web to start Tirai

statusLoggedOut.message: Log in to WhatsApp Web first. Tirai starts when your chats appear.

pillPage.message: Curtain on this tab · $SHORTCUT$ to remove

uncoverTab.message: Remove the curtain from this tab

statusOtherTab.message: Tirai works automatically on WhatsApp Web. You can also cover this tab.

modeHelpNormal.message: Your chat list is covered. The chat you open stays readable.

modeHelpFull.message: Everything is covered. Point at a line to read it.

ruleHelpHide.message: Stays covered even in Normal mode.

ruleHelpShow.message: Stays readable even in Full mode.

switchSensitiveHelp.message: ID, bank account and card numbers, OTP codes and phone numbers. Point at one to read it.

switchShare.message: Cover everything while I share my screen

switchShareHelp.message: Works with Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Discord and Slack in this browser. Reload meeting tabs that are already open.

switchShareDenied.message: Permission was not given, so this stays off.

switchUnfocus.message: Cover when the WhatsApp window is not active

switchUnfocusHelp.message: Useful when you present from the Zoom or Teams app.

switchIdle.message: Cover when I leave the computer

statusUnfocus.message: WhatsApp Web is covered while its window is not active

statusIdle.message: WhatsApp Web is covered while you are away

welcomeBody1.message: Open WhatsApp Web. Your chat list is covered, and the chat you open stays readable.

welcomeBody2.message: Point at a chat to read it. Press $FULL$ to cover everything before you present.

welcomeBody3.message: ID numbers, bank account numbers and OTP codes stay masked even in the chat you open.

lampHelp.message: The band under your cursor. 72 px fits one chat row.

sensitiveHelp.message: Masks only change what is shown. Copying still copies the real text.

idleLabel.message: Seconds before the computer counts as left

rulesEmpty.message: No chat rules yet. Open a chat in WhatsApp Web, then choose a rule in the Tirai menu.

privacyBody.message: Tirai works only on this computer. It sends nothing over the internet, and settings and chat rules stay in this browser.

privacyLimit.message: Tirai protects against people looking at your screen. It does not protect against someone who can use this computer.

appLockTip.message: To lock WhatsApp Web with a password, use its own App Lock: Settings, then Privacy, then App lock.
